definitions.full: H1803. dallah I. דַּלָּה noun feminine collective, hair, thrum (both front hanging down) — דַּלָּה Isa 38:12 ; construct דַּלַּת Cant 7:6; — hair , ׳ד ראשׁך Cant 7:6; thrum (threads of warp hanging in loom) in simile of premature death יְבַצְּעֵנִי מִדַּלָּה 38:12 . II.
